m: Meatballs: mix both minces with the panko, egg, half the parmesan, half the garlic (crushed), chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt. Roll into golf-ball sizes, about 5 per serve.
Brown the meatballs all over in a big pan with a little oil. Set aside.
Same pan: soften the diced onion 5 minutes, then the rest of the garlic and the oregano for 1 minute.
Add the passata and crushed tomatoes, return the meatballs and simmer, half covered, 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta, keep a mug of the water, and toss with some sauce.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over pasta with the rest of the parmesan.
l: Meatballs and sauce reheat beautifully. Use the pasta water to loosen it.
g: GF crumbs in a separate small batch of meatballs, cooked first, and GF pasta in its own pot.
